title: Tensor-unit identification of the finite root tower
statement: For a prime l, scheme T, Chern data c for ULift Q_l [def-sp-tower-class-chern], and a section-preserving residue Restriction r [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], the additive tower underlying r applied to lineModule c is isomorphic to the actual roots tower. For each original root-module section x and its identified forgotten section x-prime, the isomorphism sends scalarExtensionSection(x) to c.rootForget(x-prime). This assertion constructs no completed root-limit projection, coefficient-unit comparison or restriction functor.

source.place: paragraph (1), ordinary scalar restrictions before right derivation

proof.text: Use the proved coefficientMap_iso helper in DiagonalTraceCoefficientIdentification: the lifted valuation ring of Q_l is Z_l, and its quotient by l^(n+1) is Z/l^(n+1). The component characterization of systemMap shows coefficientSystemMap is sectionwise an isomorphism, hence an isomorphism of sheaves of rings.

Restriction along this ring-sheaf isomorphism is an equivalence, realized by Mathlib pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence on the identity site equivalence. Thus the unit of c.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction is invertible. Its unit_section equation identifies its section map with scalarExtensionSection, by cancellation of the specified obj_eq transport.

Construct the comparison of r(M) with c.reduction.forget(res(M)) by the section equalities. The restrictions and transitions equations give naturality of these component identity transports, so they give a tower isomorphism. For M = lineModule, compose this with the inverse of the forgotten ordinary unit and c.rootForget. The morphisms equation of c.reduction.forget and the unit_section formula show the specified pure tensor is sent to the identified original root section, proving the asserted normalization.

theorem exists_diagonalTraceLineIdentification (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (c : Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T) :
    ∃ e : r.F.obj (lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c) ⋙
        diagonalForget l T ≅ roots l T,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : c.rootModule.val.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
        (x' : ((c.reduction.forget.F.obj c.rootModule).obj (op n)).obj.obj U)
        (v : ((r.F.obj (lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)).obj (op n)).obj.obj U),
        HEq x x' →
        HEq v (SemilinearSections.scalarExtensionSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSystemMap l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T) c.scalar c.rootModule
          (op (n, U.unop)) x) →
        (e.hom.app (op n)).hom.app U v =
          (c.rootForget.hom.app (op n)).hom.app U x'
